name: repo-city
title_zh: 一座能走进去的代码城，每栋楼都是模块
tagline_zh: 每个模块是一栋楼，楼高是真实指标，道路是调用关系。所有结论都标注在源码行旁——新人上手、架构评审、给外行讲清楚。
tagline_en: Modules become buildings, heights are real metrics, roads are call sites. Every claim sits beside its source.
desc_en: Turn any repository into one self-contained interactive HTML page — an isometric city where each module is a building, height is a measured metric, roads are real call sites, and every claim is rendered beside the source line it came from. Use when someone asks to visualise, map, diagram, or explain the architecture of a codebase, onboard onto an unfamiliar repo, or produce a shareable architectur
why_zh: 不是画示意图，而是把代码度量直接映射成城市尺度——楼高、路网、街区都从仓库里算出来，所见即所测。
why_en: Not a diagram—a direct mapping of code metrics to city scale. Heights, roads, blocks are computed from the repo, so what you see.
limit_zh: 只接受能克隆的 Git 仓库；产物是单页 HTML，不含交互式代码导航或点击跳转源码。超大仓库（>10万行）生成慢。
limit_en: Requires a clonable Git repo. Output is a static HTML page—no clickable code navigation. Very large repos (>100k lines) generate slowly; layout is.
title_en: A walkable code city where each module is a building
